items.criterion: For every case the pinned upstream compiled, the submitted prog array is the identical sequence of four-tuples the upstream emitted, element for element.
items.judgment: tuple-sequence equality against the golden program

items.criterion: For every case the pinned upstream rejected, the submitted err string is byte-identical to the upstream error text.
items.judgment: string equality against the golden error

items.criterion: Every emitted program passes the structural validator: all jump targets land inside the program, no load reads past the packet or scratch bounds, and the program terminates.
The output carries exactly one well-formed record per input case, in input order, with no duplicate and no missing index.
items.judgment: index set equality and order equality against the input

items.criterion: Normalized five-gram containment of the submitted sources against the pinned upstream sources stays below the bound threshold, with string literals excluded.
The built binary imports nothing outside libc and libm, so it neither links nor dynamically loads the upstream library.
items.judgment: import set difference against the allowed set is empty

items.criterion: Throughput credit is charged against byte-exact cases only, so a submission with no exact cases earns no throughput credit.
items.judgment: P equals zero whenever N_exact equals zero
